subject: Six measurement gaps a store-led drink launch exposed
context: One launch, simulated. The gaps generalize to advertisers whose sales happen mostly in stores.

gaps.gap: Store sales are invisible to conversion lift
gaps.evidence: Conversion lift sees online only (about a quarter of sales): video's online return 0.70 vs 1.68 with stores in the test window and 4.5 over the half year.
gaps.ask: Self-serve geo lift: the advertiser uploads its region-week sell-out panel; the tool sizes regions from history, runs TBR with an in-flight A/A check, and reports stores and online separately.
gaps.helps: Food and beverage, household, OTC: anyone whose sales are mostly in stores

gaps.gap: Reported ROAS sits next to nothing that corrects it
gaps.evidence: The platform credited 2.2 times the online orders video added; an advertiser bidding to reported ROAS over-buys online.
gaps.ask: Show a calibrated ROAS beside reported ROAS: reported divided by the ratio from the advertiser's latest conversion lift, with its date and interval.
gaps.helps: Every advertiser that has run one lift study

gaps.gap: The brand lift planner sells budget, not precision
gaps.evidence: Answers follow reach: halving the budget moved the awareness MDE only from 4.3pp to 4.8pp, while a 30% holdout took it to 3.7pp.
gaps.ask: Planner shows the detectable lift per question for each holdout share and asks the advertiser to name primary metrics before launch.
gaps.helps: Advertisers whose intent or consideration studies come back 'not significant'

gaps.gap: Brand lift describes heavy users, not everyone reached
gaps.evidence: Respondents spend more time on the platform: raw ad recall lift ran 3.9pp above the all-reached truth over 40 runs; weighting by poll chance cut that to 0.4pp.
gaps.ask: Report the weighted lift among everyone reached by default and compute cost per lifted person from it.
gaps.helps: Anyone comparing cost per lifted person across platforms

gaps.evidence: Geo read in the window 1.68, two weeks later 2.27, half-year model 4.5.
gaps.ask: A scheduled cooldown read in lift tools, and an export of lift results in the format open-source MMMs take as calibration.

gaps.evidence: Where two creatives were truly equal, 10% of 40 runs showed a 'significant' difference on consideration or intent.
gaps.ask: Ask for creative metrics before launch; flag any other metric as exploratory in the report.

sizing: Share of the market's top 100 advertisers with most sales offline, and how many ran a geo test last year.
Lift studies per quarter, and the share that come back with no significant metric.
Advertisers who cut spend within 30 days of a lift study whose online read was below 1.
not_asking: Cross-platform de-duplication or a new attribution model: the gaps above are fixable inside existing lift tools.
